author: Darinos
quote:
Disappointed is the right word. The game is neutered and nerfed. We hoped GTA was spared from the **** that happens to so many products, but unfortunately we are left with a giant woke turd. GTA has lost what it was, and what it stood for. The graphics are good but I still chose to give it 0 rating since I see so many fake positive short reviews with no explanation to why they think its so great. 

RIP GTA 1998 - 2013

It couldn't last forever!
